args.title: Juniper Labware newsletter summary — Warehouse automation in 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: Juniper Labware's latest issue covers "Warehouse automation in 2026," linking to a blog article and offering project-matched companion case studies (retrieved for project NIGHTJAR).
- Article: Autonomous carts lifted pick rates by 18% in 2026 warehouse automation deployments, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece: The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
